task_summary: Registered complete official capstone roster: 1 Instructor (Rozanne Tuesday Flores), 4 Students (Patrick Josh Añedez [lead], Throylan Antipuesto, Steven Joe Bautista, Chijay Canoy), and 5 Faculty Committee Members (Glaiza Mae Libe [adviser], Louie Labastida [panel chair], Raul Lecaros [panel 2], Joseph Abella [panel 3], Joan Marie Panes [secretary]). Bound academic foundation to new instructor and verified authentication across all roles.
lessons_learned: Lesson: Student accounts should be bound to their active academic Section (sectionId) and course instructor (instructorId) upon registration so student dashboards automatically load cohort metadata and institutional templates.

Prevention: When migrating from placeholder credentials to official rosters, clean up temporary seed accounts (such as generic instructor@buksu.edu.ph) and reassign createdBy references on AcademicYear, Course, and Section to the official Instructor to avoid orphaned permissions.

Runbook / Checklist for Roster Seeding: 1. Confirm primary user role mapping (Student, Instructor, Faculty). 2. For faculty appointments (Adviser, Panelist, Secretary, Chair), tag under facultyRole or panelist assignments. 3. Validate live authentication probes with bcrypt-hashed passwords across all persona groups to ensure zero login lockouts.
